note: The legal basis on which each authority acts. source "inventory": from the authority inventory (kc-world, Wwft art. 1d per supervisor); "casefold": written here, to verify.

NL:dnb.basis: Art. 1d(1)(a) Wwft (institutions in art. 1a(2) and 1a(3)(a,b,e,f,g,j), banks/EMIs offering crypto-asset services (1a(3)(k)), and trust offices (1a(4)(f))); Sanctiewet 1977 and Rtsw

NL:afm.basis: Art. 1d(1)(b) Wwft (institutions in art. 1a(3)(c,d,h,i), crypto-asset service providers other than banks/EMIs (1a(3)(k)), managers under art. 1a(6))

NL:deken.basis: Art. 1d(1)(d) Wwft jo. art. 22(2) Advocatenwet (institutions in art. 1a(4)(c))

NL:dfei.basis: Art. 1d(1)(e) Wwft (Minister of Finance; institutions in art. 1a(4)(g,h,i,j,k,m,n)); exercised by DFEI since 1 Jan 2026 (previously Belastingdienst/Bureau Toezicht Wwft); also UBO-register enforcement and the EUR 3,000 cash ban for goods traders (Wet plan van aanpak witwassen, in force 1 Jan 2026)

NL:ksa.basis: Art. 1d(1)(f) Wwft (institutions in art. 1a(4)(l): gambling providers under the Wet op de kansspelen)

NL:fiu-nl.basis: Arts. 12-13 Wwft (receives and analyses UTRs); art. 17a Wwft suspension orders since 1 July 2026; not a supervisor (supervision per art. 1d Wwft)

NL:ap.basis: Not an AML supervisor; GDPR Art. 51 and art. 6 Uitvoeringswet AVG (UAVG)

NL:kvk.basis: Handelsregisterwet 2007 (UBO register); receives discrepancy reports under Wwft art. 10c

EU:ecb.basis: SSM Regulation (EU) 1024/2013: grants and withdraws banking licences on a proposal of DNB; prudential supervision of significant banks

EU:amla.basis: Verordening (EU) 2024/1620: direct AML supervision of selected credit and financial institutions and crypto-asset service providers from 2028; indirect oversight of national supervisors

NL:fiod.basis: Investigates money laundering and economic offences, including violations of the Wwft and the Sanctiewet 1977 (Wet op de economische delicten)

NL:om.basis: Prosecutes money laundering and economic offences (Wet op de economische delicten), including violations of the Wwft and the Sanctiewet 1977

NL:bz.basis: Sanctions policy and exemptions (ontheffingen) under the Sanctiewet 1977 and the EU sanctions regulations, together with other ministries

NL:douane.basis: Declaration of cash of EUR 10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU (Verordening (EU) 2018/1672)

NL:nba.basis: Licensing body: Wet op het accountantsberoep

NL:kroon.basis: Licensing body: Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet; Wet op het notarisambt

NL:gemeente.basis: Licensing body: Gemeentewet / local by-law (APV); Wok art. 30b

NL:knvb.basis: Licensing body: FIFA Football Agent Regulations; KNVB licensing regulations

NL:tbd.basis: To be designated by AMvB under the Iwt (art. 1.3, consultation version) for the sectors that come under the AMLR

NL:none-aml.basis: Not an obliged entity under the Wwft or the AMLR: no AML supervisor
